why_no_new_terms: The draft is the novel's text: it renders what the pages already name. Its one defined thing, the Innere Weite, is glossed as the Überwelt by three read sources and already read there (J95); its section names (Stille Wacht, Erste Berührung, Algorithmischer Schrecken, …) are the crisis sequence the plans list, and belong on the chapter page

internal_tension: Kael arises twice: in Kap 0 as the remainder the Trennungsprotokoll cuts from the subsystems that hosted the Funken-Ich (L473, L485, L505), in Kap 40 as „das Cluster, das aus Komponente 734 herausgetrennt wurde“ (L63). The Vorwort's „wir“ is general, Kap 40's is the plural Wir, and Kap 40 says the Vorwort's was already it (L27–L35). Kap 40 ends twice, on the shards and on „Das Universum hält“
setzungen_of_the_abhandlung: all three are in the draft: the voice is the Wir (L31), the warmth is in the Resonanzkaskade (L401) and echoed (L75), the shards follow two falling glasses and are carried without a mirror (L271, L473, L513, L123, L127). The draft does not name the treatise
